scope.quote: since there is no guards on `BuilderWallet.init`, anyone can call it and overwrite the `builderAdmin` address, which is used to guard `sweep` from being called by anyone. In practice, any builder fees accumulated in these wallets can be stolen because of that.
Because this vulnerability leads to consistent user / builder loss of funds, I think this qualifies as a *high* vuln
